name_orig: Ioannes Lvdovicus Vives Valentinus / Lodouicus Vives Valentinus
born: 1492, Valencia (general knowledge; not confirmed from a fetched source in this task)
died: 1540, Bruges (per Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy entry, fetched via search summary; date 1540 is general knowledge)
role_place: Valencian humanist and educator active in Leuven, England and Bruges; his censure of Muhammad and the Qur'an is excerpted in the Basel 1543 Bibliander volume, Tomus II.
why_relevant: Excerpt 'De Mahumete et Alcorano eius censura' names Muhammad's wife Aysa and says he took her as a virgin while she was still a young girl (iuvenculam).
fame: Among the best-known Spanish humanists of the 16th century (education, Augustine commentary, De veritate fidei Christianae); his Islam excerpt is much less known than his other works.
community: Latin Catholic (humanist); the excerpt was printed by Protestant printers in Basel (Oporinus) with Bibliander's editorial matter.
